arabic text: AAKE RASIYON SE, SAKINA KO, CHHURALO BABA
english translation text: O BABA, COME AND FREE ME FROM THESE CHAINS

arabic text: AAKE RASIYON SE, SAKINA KO, CHHURALO BABA\nMAI HUN MUSHKIL ME MUJHE PAAS BULAALO BABA
english translation text: O BABA, COME AND FREE ME FROM THESE CHAINS,\nI AM SURROUNDED BY DIFFICULTIES, PLEASE CALL ME TO YOU O BABA,

arabic text: BHAAGTE UNTH SE, BABA MAI KAYYI BAAR GIRRI\nDURR BHI CHEENAY MERE DE-KHO MERI POSHAK JALLI\nMUJHKO ZINDAAN KE, ANDHERO SE, NIKAALO BABA
english translation text: O BABA, MANY TIMES HAVE I FALLEN OFF A RUNNING CAMEL,\nMY EARINGS WERE SNATCHED, AND MY CLOTHES WERE BURNT,\nO BABA, TAKE ME OUT OF THE DARKNESS OF THIS PRISON

arabic text: NEEND AATI NAHI, SONE SE BHI DARR LAGTA HAI\nLOON JO KARWAT TO MERE, KAANO SE KHOON RISTA HAI\nAPNE SEENE PE, GHARRI PAL TO, SULAALO BABA
english translation text: I AM UNABLE TO SLEEP, I AM EVEN AFRAID OF SLEEPING,\nMY EAR BLEEDS WHEN I TURN MY SIDE,\nFOR A LITTLE WHILE PLEASE LET ME SLEEP ON YOUR CHEST

arabic text: SHIMR SE MAANGOON JO, PAANI TO JHIRAK DETA HAI\nPHIR MERE SAAMNE MA-TTI PE GIRAA DETA HAI\nBHEJ KE GHAZI KO, DO GHOONT, MANGAALO BABA
english translation text: SHIMR SNEERS AT ME WHEN I ASK HIM FOR WATER,\nIN FRONT OF ME HE SPILLS WATER ON THE GROUND,\nO BABA, PLEASE SEND MY UNCLE TO FETCH SOME WATER TAUNT

arabic text: TERE KAATIL MUJHE, RONE SE MANAA KARTE HAIN\nJABHI ROTI HUN TO A-BID PE SITAM KARTE HAIN\nKHUL KE ROWLOON MUJHE, NAIZE PE, UTHAALO BABA
english translation text: YOUR KILLERS DON’T ALLOW ME TO CRY FOR YOU,\nTHEY WHIP IMAM SAJJAD WHEN I CRY,\nTAKE ME WITH YOU ON YOUR SPEAR SO I CAN CRY WITHOUT FEAR

arabic text: NAA KOI MUJHKO BULAA-TA HAI SAKINA KEH KE\nSHAAM KE LOG BULAA-TE HAIN YATEEMA KEH KE\nTHOKRAIN KHAATI, SAKINA KO, SAMBHAALO BABA
english translation text: NO CALLS ME BY MY NAME,\nPEOPLE OF SHAAM CALL ME AN ORPHAN,\nSAKINA IS FALLING, HELP ME BABA

arabic text: BAAL KHENCHE HAIN MERE, MU PE TAMAACHE MAARE\nDEKH KE GHAZI KE SAR, KO RAHAY HASTE SAARE\nHAIY ZARRA APNA, WAFADAAR, JAGAALO BABA
english translation text: THEY PULL MY HAIR, AND THEY SLAP ME,\nTHEY LAUGH WHILE LOOKING AT THE HEAD OF ABBAS (A.S.),\nWAKE UP YOUR LOYAL BROTHER, O BABA
